newsitem.title: USA: NYS says plans first variable rate issue in Q1 '97.
newsitem.headline: NYS says plans first variable rate issue in Q1 '97.

text.p: New York State plans to sell its first variable rate general obligation debt issue in the first quarter of 1997, the state's assistant deputy comptroller said Monday.
The size of the issue to be about $150 million, Barbara Mickens Washington, the state official, said. The sale would be part of a series of debt issues.
Mickens Washington was speaking at a Bond Buyer New York Public Finance Conference here.
"It is the inaugural issue," she said, adding that the issue's structure will provide the state with financial flexibility.
State authorities have sold variable rate debt in the past, but the planned sale by the state would be its first variable rate offering.
